value.rationale: The triangular book is a natural edge-sharing extreme of finite excitation networks. Its two rules have precisely the same recurrent 3-cycle skeleton and basin, but the nonperiodic GHM oscillatory attraction basin is partitioned into three exactly equal first-entry shells while CCA collapses to one shell. The exact equality for every size and its contrasting limiting stopping-time laws go beyond a routine oscillation-existence test and meaningfully quantify how dynamical transients differ even at identical recurrent behavior.
